name: Vestige
author: samvallad33
description: Vestige 3.0.0: open-source local memory for AI coding agents. Resume sessions with current source context, retrieve bounded evidence, save automatically, manage intentions, and trace earlier candidate causes with Backfill. Launch npx -y vestige-mcp-server@3.0.0 or an installed vestige-mcp. All 15 MCP tools are included. Binaries: macOS Apple Silicon/Intel, Linux x64/ARM64, Windows x64. Data stays on your machine.

tools.name: backfill
tools.description: Investigate a recorded failure using earlier memories sharing entities. Results are hypotheses, not proven causes. Default promote=false previews without graph or strength changes; explicit promote=true records candidate edges and reinforces eligible memories after review. scope defaults to user; failure_id defaults to the latest failure in that scope.

failure_id.description: Failure memory to backfill from. Omitted: the most recent failure-like memory.

lookback_days.description: How many days back to reach for the cause. Default 30.

manual.description: Force the backfill when the event is not auto-detected as salient. Default false.

promote.description: Explicitly reinforce candidates and record candidate edges after review. Default false: preview only, with no graph or strength mutation. Promotion does not verify causality.

scan_limit.description: Max memories to scan as candidate causes. Default 500.

scope.description: Exact project namespace for failure and candidates. Defaults to user; cross-project inference is not performed.

tools.name: codebase
tools.description: Code memory. Actions: 'remember_pattern', 'remember_decision', 'get_context' (patterns and decisions, each marked current or stale), 'verify' (check a bounded set of anchors), 'reanchor' (replace reviewed source evidence for an existing memory).

action.description: 'remember_pattern' stores a code pattern, 'remember_decision' an architectural decision, 'get_context' returns both with a current-or-stale mark, 'verify' checks a bounded set of anchored memories, 'reanchor' explicitly replaces reviewed source anchors for memoryId

anchors.description: Structured form of 'files'; each anchor is content-hashed at save time.

symbol.description: Function, type or class this is about. Prefer over line numbers, which rot.

files.description: Files touched: 'src/a.py', 'src/a.py#symbol', or 'src/a.py:10-20'. Anything beyond a bare path is content-hashed so staleness is detectable.

memoryId.description: Existing code memory to reanchor after reviewing its advice against source

repoPath.description: Explicit checkout for get_context evidence. Remember/verify actions retain the server working-directory fallback.

verify.description: Re-check returned code memories against the source and flag stale ones (default true).

tools.name: dedup
tools.description: Duplicates, merges, supersession, and exact tag maintenance. Actions: 'scan' (default, read-only: duplicate clusters and merge candidates), 'plan_merge' (member_ids to plan_id), 'plan_supersede' (old_id, new_id to plan_id), 'apply' (run a plan_id; confirm=true is required unless the current policy explicitly allows auto-applying strong matches), 'undo' (reverse an operation_id, or omit to list the reflog), 'tag_rename' and 'tag_merge' (preview-token gated), 'protect' (pin against auto-merge), 'policy' (get or set match thresholds). Merged memories are invalidated, never deleted.

action.description: 'scan' (default, read-only): duplicate clusters and merge candidates. 'plan_merge' / 'plan_supersede': preview a reversible plan. 'apply': run a plan_id. 'undo': reverse an operation_id, or list the reflog. 'tag_rename' / 'tag_merge': preview-token gated. 'protect': pin a memory. 'policy': thresholds.

all_scopes.description: [tag_*] Operate across every scope. Default false.

auto_apply.description: [policy] Apply 'match' plans without confirm. Default false.

confirm.description: [apply, tag_*] Explicit confirmation. Tag actions preview when false and need preview_token when true.

member_ids.description: [plan_merge] Two or more memory ids; the survivor is kept, the rest invalidated.

operation_id.description: [undo] Operation to reverse. Omit to list recent operations plus tagOperations.

plan_id.description: [apply] Plan id from plan_merge or plan_supersede.

preview_token.description: [tag_* confirm=true] Token from the matching preview.

protected.description: [protect] true to pin, false to unpin.

similarity_threshold.description: [scan] Minimum cosine similarity for clusters (0.5 to 1, default 0.80).

source_tags.description: [tag_merge] Two or more exact source tags.

tags.description: [scan] Only memories with any of these tags.

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Memory graph: 'chain', 'associations', 'bridges', 'predict', 'memory_graph', composition topology ('recent', 'get', 'memory', 'neighbors', 'never_composed', 'bounty_mode'), 'label' (the only write).

action.description: Reasoning: 'chain' (from, to), 'associations' (from), 'bridges' (from, to), 'predict' (context), 'memory_graph' (center_id or query). Composition: 'recent', 'get' (event_id), 'memory', 'neighbors' (memory_id), 'never_composed', 'bounty_mode', 'label' (records an outcome; the only write).

includeCrossScope.description: [never_composed only] Explicitly consider candidates across project namespaces.

query.description: [memory_graph] Pick a center node by search query.

scope.description: [never_composed only] Exact project namespace; filtered before candidate scan limits. Other graph actions do not accept this control.

tools.name: intention
tools.description: Intentions. Actions: 'set', 'check', 'update', 'list'; 'graph' evaluates evidence-aware plans, premises, attention, completion and replay through a nested command.

trigger.description: A simple, recurring, activity, or bounded compound trigger.

activity.description: Activity whose completion is matched against check context events

at.description: Absolute RFC3339 trigger or recurrence anchor (UTC-normalized on storage)

condition.description: Case-insensitive text matched against check context events

in_minutes.description: Minutes from creation; zero fires immediately

recurrence.description: Named cadence or a bounded absolute interval. Fortnightly is exactly 20,160 minutes.

oneOf.description: hourly, daily, weekly, fortnightly, or 'every N minutes/hours/days/weeks/fortnights'

inputSchema.description: Unified intention management tool. Supports setting, checking, updating (complete/snooze/cancel), and listing intentions.

action.description: 'set' creates, 'check' finds triggered, 'update' changes status, 'list' shows.

at.description: [graph] Explicit evaluation clock for reproducible fixtures; defaults to now.

command.description: [graph] Evidence-aware plan/revise/observe/evaluate/explain/portfolio/complete/cancel/acknowledge. replay checks committed history. memory_snapshot reads a scoped content digest; refresh_memory observes it using memory_id,event_id,source_revision. No external actions or fact verification.

semantics.absence: requires an elapsed explicit requirement window plus complete source coverage of that window and named event
semantics.evaluation_records: deterministic labels, not cryptographic proof or authorization
semantics.external_effects: never performed or authorized by this engine, including purchases

event.description: Observed event key; exact case-insensitive match to an event trigger condition

events.description: Recent event or activity descriptions for event/activity triggers

id.description: [update] ID of the intention to update

scope.description: [graph] Local intention namespace, not an authorization boundary.

snooze_minutes.description: [update] Minutes to snooze for (when status is 'snooze')

after.description: Embeddings or lifecycle phase: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit after a sweep to retry failures and discover earlier inserts.

batchSize.description: Bounded phases: selected memories or log rows per call; embeddings accepts at most 100.

dry_run.description: Bounded phases: preview the selected batch without inference or mutation.

after.description: ID cursor from previous dream page. Cross-page pairs are outside this page's analysis.

max_pairs.description: Upper bound for within-page memory pairs; reduces selected memory count.

memory_count.description: Maximum memories in a scoped ID page (default: 50)

min_similarity.description: Minimum similarity for connection discovery (0.0-1.0, default: 0.5)

after.description: Live scan cursor from previous page; omit after completing a sweep.

dry_run.description: If true (default), only report what would be deleted without actually deleting

max_age_days.description: Only delete memories older than this many days (optional additional filter)

min_retention.description: Delete memories with retention below this threshold (default: 0.1)

content.description: The content to score for importance

context_topics.description: Optional topics for novelty detection context

format.description: Export format: 'json' (default), 'jsonl', or 'portable' for exact Vestige-to-Vestige transfer

path.description: Custom filename (not path). File is saved in the active Vestige data directory's exports/ folder. Default: memories-{timestamp}.{format}

since.description: Only export memories created after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

allowAnyPath.description: Allow restoring from a file outside the active Vestige backups/ or exports/ directories. Only set true for trusted local files.

merge.description: For portable archives, merge into the current database instead of requiring an empty target. Applies sync tombstones and keeps newer local memory rows on conflict.

path.description: Path to a regular backup JSON file, at most 64 MiB. Legacy batches are limited to 10000 memories and applied atomically.

action.description: Store-wide maintenance: consolidate, dream, gc (preview by default), importance_score, backup, export, restore. Inspect the selected action's schema. Export uses since; start/end are unsupported.

after.description: [gc] Live scan cursor from previous page; omit after completing a sweep.

allowAnyPath.description: [restore] Allow restoring from a file outside the active Vestige backups/ or exports/ directories. Only set true for trusted local files.

content.description: [importance_score] The content to score for importance

context_topics.description: [importance_score] Optional topics for novelty detection context

dry_run.description: [gc] If true (default), only report what would be deleted without actually deleting

format.description: [export] Export format: 'json' (default), 'jsonl', or 'portable' for exact Vestige-to-Vestige transfer

max_age_days.description: [gc] Only delete memories older than this many days (optional additional filter)

max_pairs.description: [dream] Upper bound for within-page memory pairs; reduces selected memory count.

memory_count.description: [dream] Maximum memories in a scoped ID page (default: 50)

merge.description: [restore] For portable archives, merge into the current database instead of requiring an empty target. Applies sync tombstones and keeps newer local memory rows on conflict.

min_retention.description: [gc] Delete memories with retention below this threshold (default: 0.1)

min_similarity.description: [dream] Minimum similarity for connection discovery (0.0-1.0, default: 0.5)

path.description: [export] Confined filename inside exports/. [restore] JSON archive path, confined unless allowAnyPath=true for a trusted file.

since.description: [export] Only export memories created after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Manage one memory: 'get', 'get_batch', 'state', 'promote' / 'demote' (demote never deletes), 'edit' (keeps FSRS state), 'purge' (for good; confirm=true). 'delete' aliases purge.

action.description: 'get', 'get_batch' (ids), 'state', 'promote' / 'demote' (retrieval strength; demote never deletes), 'edit' (replace content, keep FSRS state), 'purge' (content and embeddings gone; confirm=true). 'delete' aliases purge

confirm.description: Required for purge and delete. Removes canonical content and embeddings; legacy audit and sync rows keep opaque markers, so this is not verified unlearning.

content.description: [edit] New content; embedding regenerated, FSRS state kept.

tools.name: memory_status
tools.description: Store status. view 'health' (default: stats, decay preview, module health, warnings), 'retention' (average, distribution, trend), 'timeline' (memories by day), 'changelog' (state-change audit trail), 'stats' (hygiene counts by type, tag, age, retention, lifecycle), 'tools' (all advertised tools and actions; pass tool for its full input schema).

limit.description: Max results: timeline 50 (max 200), changelog 20 (max 100), stats lists 50 (max 200). Ignored by health and retention.

memory_id.description: [changelog] State transitions for this memory only.

scope.description: [stats] Scope to aggregate (default 'user'); ignored when all_scopes.

tool.description: [tools view] Exact advertised tool name. Omit for a compact inventory of every tool and action; specify a name for its complete input schema. This is discovery, not tool execution.

view.description: 'tools': current tool/action inventory, or one full schema with tool. 'health' (default): system health, stats, decay preview, warnings, recommendations. 'retention': average, distribution, trend. 'timeline': memories by date. 'changelog': state-change audit trail. 'stats': hygiene counts by type, tag, age, retention, and lifecycle, with bounded detail lists and recent tag operations.

tools.name: project
tools.description: Project the durable subset of a scope (decisions, patterns, rule-tagged facts) into a fenced region of CLAUDE.md or MEMORY.md, a memory id on every line. 'preview' (default) shows the diff; 'write' needs confirm=true and replaces only the fence, never the rest of the file.

action.description: 'preview' (default) renders and diffs, writes nothing. 'write' replaces the fenced region in 'path'; needs confirm=true.

confirm.description: Required for write. Only the fenced region changes; the rest of the file is kept byte for byte.

format.description: 'claude-md': a grouped section for CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md. 'memory-md': one line per memory for an index file.

min_retention.description: Leave out memories below this retention.

path.description: Target file, relative to 'root'. Required for write; a preview diffs against it when given.

root.description: Directory the target must stay inside (default: the server's working directory).

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve from memory. mode 'lookup' (default): fast hybrid keyword and semantic search. 'reason': deep pass with trust scoring, spreading activation, supersession, and contradictions; needs 'query', use when accuracy matters; its text is assembled from computed values, not written by a model. 'contradictions': disagreement pairs for a 'topic'. Reason mode records composition evidence; retrieval never changes strength; promote what helped via memory.

inputSchema.description: Mode-specific retrieval. lookup supports the lookup schema. reason supports query, depth, limit, scope/includeCrossScope, retention/similarity/type/tag/validAt/source filters, and token_budget, while rejecting lookup-only controls. contradictions supports topic, since, min_trust, limit, and scope/includeCrossScope; it rejects token_budget and lookup/reason filters instead of silently ignoring them.

concrete.description: [lookup mode only; reason returns an unsupported-field error] Literal search, no semantic expansion or side effects. Auto-on for quoted strings, env vars, UUIDs, paths, identifiers.

context_packet.description: [lookup only] Return stable evidence cards with a packet ID. Scores are omitted; cards are ordered by ID for client reuse. No provider cache or savings guarantee.

context_topics.description: [lookup mode only; reason returns an unsupported-field error] Topics that boost context-dependent retrieval.

depth.description: [reason mode] How many memories to analyze (default 20, max 50).

detail_level.description: [lookup mode only; reason returns an unsupported-field error] 'brief': id, type, tags, score. 'summary' (default): 8 fields. 'full': everything, including FSRS state.

exclude_types.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Node types to exclude (reflections are excluded by default).

includeCrossScope.description: Search every project namespace. Only when cross-project retrieval is intended.

include_types.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Only these node types; overrides exclude_types.

known_packet_id.description: [lookup only] Send only while the previous complete packet remains in the model context. Matching packets return notModified=true and no cards. Omit after context loss to refresh.

min_retention.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Minimum retention strength, 0 to 1 (default 0).

min_similarity.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Minimum similarity, 0 to 1 (default 0.5).

min_trust.description: [contradictions mode] Minimum trust for both sides of a contradiction (default 0.3).

mode.description: 'lookup' (default): fast hybrid search. 'reason': scoped deep pass with heuristic ranking, spreading activation, supersession, and contradiction analysis; its text is assembled from computed values; needs 'query' and requires current-source verification for material claims. 'contradictions': trust-weighted disagreement pairs for a 'topic', or recent memories.

query.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Search query

rank_native_fusion.description: [lookup mode only; reason returns an unsupported-field error] Experimental: fuse post-retrieval stages by weighted RRF instead of multipliers.

retrieval_mode.description: [lookup mode only; reason returns an unsupported-field error] 'precise': top hits, no activation or competition. 'balanced' (default): full pipeline. 'exhaustive': 5x overfetch, deep traversal.

scope.description: Project namespace (default 'user'); project memories never bleed into an unscoped recall.

since.description: [contradictions mode] RFC3339 timestamp; only memories updated after this are considered.

source_author.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Source author or reporter (not assignee).

source_id.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Only this source record id; pair with source_system.

source_project.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Only this source project or repo, exact match.

source_status.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] 'any' (default), 'valid' (visible upstream), 'tombstoned' (removed upstream, kept for audit).

source_system.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Only memories ingested from this external system ('github', 'redmine'). Post-filter.

source_type.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Source record type, e.g. 'issue', 'comment'.

source_updated_after.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Source updated at or after this RFC3339 time.

source_updated_before.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Source updated at or before this RFC3339 time.

tag_prefix.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Only results with a tag starting with this prefix (case-insensitive). Post-filter; raise 'limit' if it thins results.

token_budget.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Max response tokens; content is truncated to fit. memory(action='get') has the full text.

topic.description: [contradictions mode] Topic to scope contradiction detection. If omitted, scans recent memories.

validAt.description: [lookup and reason modes; contradictions returns an unsupported-field error] Only facts valid at this time ('now', RFC3339, YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted: expired and future facts are downranked, not hidden.

tools.name: receipt
tools.description: Inspect a persisted retrieval receipt ('get') or ablate its frozen evidence pack ('replay'): named slots withheld, no rerun, no model, no causal claim.

action.description: 'get': one receipt with its replay-capsule summary. 'replay': withhold named evidence slots from the frozen context without rerunning retrieval.

receipt_id.description: Receipt id; replay needs a retrieval receipt with a frozen capsule.

withheld_slots.description: [replay] Slots to remove from the frozen context; search is never rerun.

tools.name: session_start
tools.description: Start-of-session context in one call: relevant memories, open intentions, status, predictions, codebase context, under one token budget.

context.description: Current context for intention matching and predictions

repoPath.description: Explicit checkout for code evidence; unavailable when omitted

token_budget.description: Serialized response budget in estimated tokens (UTF-8 bytes / 4, rounded up; not a model tokenizer). Includes metadata. Default: 1000.

tools.name: smart_ingest
tools.description: Save to memory through Prediction Error Gating: 'content' is created, merged into a similar memory, or supersedes an outdated one. Batch: 'items' (max 20).

acceptedTagSuggestions.description: Accepted input-tag to existing-tag mappings from a preflight; revalidated before ingest.

allowSecrets.description: Store a detected credential for this item. Dangerous; redact or store a reference instead.

batchMergePolicy.description: Batch only. 'force_create' (default) keeps items separate; 'smart' lets the gate merge.

content.description: What to remember; compared against existing memories (single mode).

forceCreate.description: Create even if similar content exists.

items.description: Batch: up to 20 items with the same fields as single mode, each force-created unless batchMergePolicy='smart'. For session end or before compaction.

node_type.description: fact, concept, event, person, place, note, pattern, decision, or state. 'state' snapshots expire after VESTIGE_STATE_TTL_DAYS (default 30) unless validUntil is set, then rank last with currentlyValid=false.

previewTagSuggestions.description: Read-only preflight: tag suggestions and inferred validity, nothing stored.

scope.description: Project namespace (default 'user'). Recall searches it unless includeCrossScope=true.

source.description: Source or reference for this knowledge

tags.description: Tags. Close existing same-scope tags come back as suggestions, never auto-applied.

validFrom.description: When the fact becomes true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted: one unambiguous 'as of DATE' phrase is inferred.

validUntil.description: When the fact stops being true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD, after validFrom).

tools.name: source_sync
tools.description: Index an external system into local memories that cite the source. source='github' (repo, GITHUB_TOKEN) or 'redmine' (project, REDMINE_URL, REDMINE_API_KEY). Re-runs update; reconcile=true tombstones removals.

max_pages.description: Max API pages per run (100 issues each); resume a large first sync across calls. Default 10.

project.description: Redmine: project slug or id. Host from REDMINE_URL.

reconcile.description: Also tombstone local memories for issues gone upstream (full enumeration). Default false.

tools.name: suppress
tools.description: Inhibit a memory without deleting it: out of retrieval, faster decay, compounding per call, neighbours affected over 72 hours. reverse=true undoes it within 24 hours.

inputSchema.description: Top-down suppression (Anderson 2025 SIF, Davis Rac1): the memory persists but is inhibited from retrieval and decays faster. Each call compounds. A background worker spreads accelerated decay to co-activated neighbours over 72 hours. Local state is reversible within 24 hours when its snapshot still matches. Journaled cascade effects are reversed atomically when neighbor state still matches.

reverse.description: If true, reverse a previous suppression. Requires a matching snapshot within the 24-hour labile window; later state changes and legacy suppressions need review. Includes journaled neighbor cascades when their state still matches.
